## 0. Card
- **WS-13 `real-house-and-data`.** Goal: two real houses captured on a regular non-Pro iPhone in both flows plus one LiDAR-phone session each, with team-measured truth, scored end to end through the deployed pipeline: R1 is a house the team measures and expects to **pass** under rule sets A and C, R2 an expected **reject**. The pass path has never been exercised: across 102 photo-model verdicts E2E found 0 unsafe passes, but no ETH3D or walkaround site has a labelled passing spot anywhere, so that figure cannot detect an unsafe pass (`internal/breadth/E2E-criteria-on-recon.md` §1, §7). Also: the meter dimension table v1 with per-entry provenance; labels drafted blind and approved (the first `pass` labels in the dataset); the registry brought up to date (three more YouTube packets, five unlabelled houses labelled); the LaMAR fetchers rewritten for WS-11; landed and pending breadth reports folded into thresholds through an evidence register.
- Builder: Grok 4.7. Validator: a separate agent (any model), never the builder; report at `internal/build/validation/ws-13.md`.
- Inputs consumed: WS-00 `server/contracts`, `server/eval`, `data/fixtures/manifest.json`, `scripts/fetch_fixtures.py`, `make validate`; WS-01/02/03 API and validation; WS-11 `server.eval.replay`, `gates`, `make e2e`, `server/eval/lamar/`; WS-04/05/06/09/10 stages (for the E2E run); WS-12 `dev` deployment and `CAPTURE_API_URL`; store: `internal/packet-generator/`, `internal/eval-harness/`, `internal/criteria/`, `internal/data/`, `internal/breadth/`, `internal/context-dumps/full/`.

## 3. Interfaces
Units: metres in every JSON (`_m`); inches only in prose and on the field sheet (1 in = 0.0254 m). Frame: scene v0 `meter_anchored/v0` (origin on the ground under the meter, +y up, +z out of the wall, s along the chain, positive to the right seen from outside). Commands run with `uv run` (WS-00).

### 3.1 Team truth `real-house-truth/v0` (`data/fixtures/real-house/<id>/truth.json`)

`measurements[].id` uses the harness key-distance ids (`docs/scene-and-verdict-format.md` §6.1): `meter.height`, `corner.s[c]`, `wall.length[w]`, `opening.edge_s[o:left|right]`, `opening.bottom[o]`, `opening.top[o]`, `opening.width[o]`, `opening.gap[a~b]`, `equipment.meter_dist[o]`, `equipment.s[o]`, `facing.depth[w@s]`, `overhead.clearance[w@s]`, `ground.region_dist[m]`. Every measurement carries a `photo` showing the reading. `meter_number` is always the literal `REDACTED`.

### 3.2 Converters (`scripts/real_house/`, Python 3.12, stdlib + `jsonschema`, `numpy`; exit 0 ok, 2 schema invalid, 3 missing input, 4 privacy check failed)
```python
def truth_to_scene(truth: dict, site: str, producer_version: str = "0") -> dict: ...
# base-scene/v0: provenance.data "real", producer.path "gt-tape", scale_source "ground_truth", gravity_source
# "ground_truth", walls/chain/objects/overheads/facing from truth, ground plane y = 0, no assets,
# coverage {"method": "none: tape ground truth, no cameras"}, every element evidence "observed", source {"kind": "tape"}.
def convert(session_zip: Path, out_dir: Path, tier: Literal["arkit", "arkit_lidar"]) -> Path: ...
# Measure Lab session v2 -> packet v0.4 folder, source.kind "replay"; missing streams listed in source.notes;
# exit 3 if any keyframe lacks pose or intrinsics. Fallback only (§4-C0); never uploaded through /v1.
def scrub(packet_dir: Path, out_dir: Path, drop_frames: list[str]) -> dict: ...
# copy without streams.location, stills[].location, scaleReference.ext.serviceAddress and EXIF GPS tags
# (exiftool -gps:all= : metadata only, pixels untouched; frames are dropped, never edited) [default chosen];
# dropped keyframes removed from keyframes[], stills[], taps[] and files[]; bytes/sha256 recomputed;
# returns {"dropped": [...], "removed_fields": [...]}; exit 4 if GPS survives.
def score_kds(gt_scene: dict, recon_scene: dict) -> dict: ...   # per-KD error_in, median/p90/max, share <= 2/4/6 in
def redact(obj: dict) -> dict: ...  # every key matching meter_number|meterNumber|number_candidates -> "REDACTED"
```

### 3.3 Meter dimension table (`data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json`, consumed by WS-05)
```json
{"format": "meter-models/v1", "table_version": "1.0.0", "updated": "2026-10-01",
 "provenance_enum": ["datasheet", "standard", "caliper", "derived", "assumed", "missing"],
 "entries": [{"model_id": "itron-centron-c1s-poly", "manufacturer": "Itron", "model_family": "CENTRON",
   "type_codes": ["C1S", "C1SR", "C1SD"], "us_market": true, "form": "2S", "cover_material": "polycarbonate",
   "cover_od_m": 0.1598, "cover_od_prov": "datasheet", "ring_od_m": 0.1795, "ring_od_prov": "standard",
   "base_od_m": 0.1765, "base_od_prov": "datasheet", "rim_offset_m": 0.0686, "rim_offset_prov": "datasheet",
   "depth_overall_m": null, "depth_overall_prov": "missing", "usable_for_scale": true,
   "source": {"doc": "Itron CENTRON product sheet, dims A/B/G/C", "url": "https://na.itron.com/...",
              "accessed": "2026-10-01", "pdf_sha256": "..."},
   "licence_note": "manufacturer datasheet; numbers cited as facts, PDF not redistributed",
   "notes": "glass cover is a separate entry (6.42 in)"}]}
```
Rules enforced by `scripts/meter_models/validate_table.py` (jsonschema + checks): every `*_m` has a `*_prov`; `usable_for_scale` is true only when `cover_od_prov ∈ {datasheet, caliper}`; a numeric value with `assumed` provenance is allowed only in the single `generic-prior` entry (`usable_for_scale: false`; A9's 6.35/6.50/6.60 in); `0.150 ≤ cover_od_m ≤ 0.185`; `ring_od_m > cover_od_m`; S-base `base_od_m` within `0.1765 ± 0.002`; `caliper` rows carry `measured_by`, `n_units`, `measured_on`, `readings_m[]`; `source.url` and `accessed` are required unless provenance is `caliper` or `missing`. Dual-cover families are two entries sharing `manufacturer + model_family` and differing in `cover_material` (CENTRON poly 0.1598 m / glass 0.1631 m), which WS-05 weights 0.9/0.1 when the material was read and 0.5/0.5 otherwise. WS-05's loader (defined in `docs/build/ws-05-scale-layer.md` §3, not here): `server/scale/meter_table.py` `MeterTable.load(path)` validating against `meter_models.schema.json`, `lookup(ident, *, allow_assumed=False) -> TableMatch | TableMiss` matching `type_codes` → `manufacturer + model_family + cover_material` → fuzzy; a `usable_for_scale: false` hit is `meter_dimension_assumed` (cover provenance `assumed`/`derived`) or `meter_model_not_in_table` (`cover_od_m` null or no match), both → `scale_unresolved` with a retake request; WS-05 appends unknown models to `scale/meter_models.pending.jsonl` for this WS's caliper list. Path handed to WS-05/WS-12 as env `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH` (SD-11 scheme), default `data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json` `[default chosen]`; in the pipeline image WS-12's `GPU_IMAGE` adds `data/meter-models/` with `add_local_dir` (the only non-code directory in the image) and `secrets_for("pipeline")` sets `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH=/root/data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json` (SD-59). WS-13 owns data, schema and validator only; the directory's content travels with every image build.

## 4. Behaviour spec

### A. Meter dimension table v1 (PR-A; on the critical path of the no-LiDAR scale source)
A9 modelled 90 % table coverage, but public datasheets give a cover diameter for Itron CENTRON only and every other cover value in the Monte Carlo was assumed (`internal/context-dumps/full/a9-no-tape-scale.md` §4: `p_table` 0.35 → 0.90 moves p90 scale error 3.7 % → 2.6 %, "the biggest lever"; §6 lists the only sourced numbers; §8 asks for ~15 calipered models). Every entry therefore carries provenance per number.
1. Seed from the A9 handoff §6 table: CENTRON poly cover 6.29 in, glass 6.42 in, base/overall 6.95 in, depth 2.70 / 3.03 in (Itron sheet, dims A/B/G/C); Aclara I-210+ overall 6.94 in max, depth 5.25 in (cover `missing`); Aclara I-210 CL320 RD 6.95 in × 6.75 in; Landis+Gyr FOCUS AX / AXe body dims `missing` (packaging only); ANSI S-base 6.95 in as `standard` via the Itron sheet; sealing ring 7.065 in standard and 7.3 in non-standard (`datasheet`, product listings).
2. `TARGET_MODELS.md`: 20–30 families with `status: found | not found | foreign`. Start from the 16 families read on real plates (`internal/breadth/a9-no-tape/results/meter_model_check.csv`: Itron CENTRON C1SD, Itron OpenWay CENTRON, Aclara I-210+, Aclara/GE kV2c, GE I-60-S, GE/Chung-Hsin I-70-S, Landis+Gyr FOCUS RXR-SD, Elster AB1, Elster REX R1S, Elster A3 Alpha, Sensus iCon A, Sangamo K2A, Westinghouse D5S, Tatung D4S, Tatung TT-001; Tatung and Chung-Hsin are `foreign`, `us_market: false`) and add common US residential families to reach ≥ 20 (Itron CENTRON II, Itron OpenWay Riva, GE/Aclara I-210+c, Landis+Gyr FOCUS AXe and AXR-SD, Elster/Honeywell REX2, Sensus Stratus). A family becomes an entry only when a datasheet confirms it.
3. Per family, time-box 30 min: manufacturer spec sheet, or a public utility regulatory filing that embeds the dimensioned drawing (A9 found I-210+ in a Florida PSC filing and FOCUS in a NY DPS filing). Record each labelled dimension (label, inches as printed, metres), `url`, `accessed`, `pdf_sha256`. PDFs are not committed (copyright); keep them in the private bucket under `meter-datasheets/`. No drawing → `null` + `missing`. Never replace a null with a guess.
4. After capture day add `caliper` rows for the R1 (and R2) meters (§C6). Publish `caliper-protocol.md` (contours, two perpendicular readings, rim offset with a depth gauge, photo of every reading, plate photo with the number covered) so Base field teams can add ~15 rows as PRs (plan WS-13; A9 handoff §8).
5. Report coverage honestly in `docs/components/ws-13-real-house.md`: count of `usable_for_scale: true` entries (expect 3–8 after this task) and the `missing` list; everything else is WS-05's `meter_model_not_in_table` → `scale_unresolved` (no meter estimate; A9's generic prior is refused as assumed data), ARKit-only bound, `status: unverified`, `retake_meter_closeups`, and a `meter_models.pending.jsonl` row (WS-05 §4 step 4).
6. Versioning: semver `table_version` (patch = new source for an existing number; minor = new entry; major = schema change) plus a `CHANGELOG` section in `SOURCES.md`; WS-05 echoes `table_version` at the top level of `scale/scale.json`.

### B. Packetize, register and label the missing houses (PR-A)
1. `uv run python -m packetgen manifest --out ~/work/packets --only yt-KSXy6LFwQU4 yt-Y0DSQekoV_g yt-olz1uwI4vM8` (the plan writes `yt-KSXy4LFwQU4`; the manifest id is `yt-KSXy6LFwQU4`). `yt-olz1uwI4vM8` is ultra-wide: if its largest model registers < 30 %, rerun with `--camera-model OPENCV_FISHEYE` (new flag on `sequence`/`manifest` `[default chosen]`).
2. `uv run python -m packetgen validate ~/work/packets/<id>/packet.*.json` passes for every variant; `uv run python -m packetgen.checks ~/work/packets/<id>` passes.
3. One uncompressed tar per house into `internal/data/packets/archives/<id>.tar`, split with `split -b 60M -d -a 2` when > 100 MiB; add the three entries to `internal/data/packets/index.json`; set `not_built: []`; add manifest items to `data/fixtures/manifest.json` and commit `data/fixtures/packets/<id>/packet.<variant>.json`.
4. Label the five manifest houses without labels (`yt-KSXy6LFwQU4`, `yt-LCPBf86oloE`, `yt-Qm4b1cw8pV4`, `yt-Y0DSQekoV_g`, `yt-olz1uwI4vM8`) in `internal/criteria/house-labels.json`, following the v0.5 entry structure (truth, `expected_verdict` in source keys, `acceptable_verdicts`, `evidence` frame ids, `confidence`, `note`); export → `52 files written and valid` (13 sites × 4); mirror to `data/fixtures/labels/`; `docs/house-labels.md` → v0.6 with one section per house and a "Changes in v0.6" list (the header's "7 ready houses / 28 files" becomes 12 / 52).

### C. Capture day (PR-B). The team executes; the builder writes the sheet and briefs the crew.
- **C0 App and fallbacks.** Primary: the iOS team's v0.4 app for S1–S3, and the photo flow run **inside the app** when it offers it (plan §2), so every photo and both close-ups carry an ARKit pose: E2E could not reconstruct `yt-LCPBf86oloE` without ARKit (44/183 registered in 6 fragments) because its meter-wall frames `t0178`–`t0184`, blank stucco close-ups, do not register image-only (`E2E-criteria-on-recon.md` §5); the same happens to any real close-up taken with the session stopped. Guided fallback: PR #7 Measure Lab (`SamGu-NRX/house-scanning`, branch `t3/measure-lab`, session v2 zip) → `session_v2_to_packet.py`; it lacks `imuRaw` and 30 Hz `arkitPoses`, so the packet fails spec §6 and is scored offline only (`server.poses.run` + `score_kds.py`), never via `/v1`. Photo-flow fallback (always available, no poses): stock Camera, Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible (JPEG + EXIF), 1× lens, portrait; `uv run python -m packetgen photos --images DIR --house-id real-001 --source-kind device --purposes photo_purposes.csv` (two new flags `[default chosen]`; `photos` currently hard-codes `synthetic`); expect the close-ups to fail registration on low-texture walls and report the rate.
- **C1 Site rules.** Both houses: detached single-family, exterior socket meter reachable at 1 m, both natural ends of the meter wall reachable on foot, nobody in frame, no house number, mailbox, licence plate or neighbour's window in any frame (frame the walk to exclude them; otherwise the frame is dropped in scrub), daylight with the sun behind the camera or overcast, time logged; Texas preferred (profile C market), any state accepted.
  **R1, expected pass under A and C (required).** Checked with the laser before committing to the house, all on the meter wall, which must be a side or back wall (a street-facing-only spot is a C review); the numbers below are the spec §4.2 thresholds with a safety margin `[default chosen]`: a clear span ≥ 1.5 m (5 ft) of flush house wall starting within 1 m of the meter, holding a 31 in battery plus A's ~2 ft disconnect; no window, door, vent, hose bib, wall box, downspout or AC inside the span or within 0.91 m (3 ft) of it; no gas meter, regulator, shutoff or gas pipe within 1.83 m (6 ft) of the span (A/B 5 ft, C 3 ft); nearest drivable surface, walkway or pavers ≥ 2.13 m (7 ft) from the wall along the span (spec §4.4: 5 ft + 2 ft depth); no pool within 3.05 m (10 ft); eave or soffit ≥ 2.13 m (7 ft) above grade over the span, no porch roof, deck or stairs; ground lawn, mulch, gravel or dirt, slope ≤ 5° over 1.8 m, visible and clear ≥ 1.8 m out; nearest fence, hedge or wall facing the span ≥ 1.52 m (5 ft) away; meter working envelope 0.91 m out × 0.76 m wide clear of bushes, AC and water heater, overhead ≥ 1.83 m; panel exterior on the same wall or in the garage with a legible non-recalled brand and a visible single main (a site `pass` also needs `main_panel_type` and `panel_recall` to pass and every P12 field `no`, spec §1). Such a span also passes B and S, so the R1 labels carry `pass` under every profile.
  **R2, expected reject under C (required).** Every reachable candidate clearly fails and both natural ends are seen (spec §4.3): the whole meter wall fronted by a drive within 0.91 m (a parked car proves it drivable) or gas plus openings leaving no 0.91 m gap, and the adjacent walls out of the 7.92 m (26 ft) routed reach or blocked by a garage door or driveway crossing. A P12 `yes` (fixed AC, water heater or bush inside the meter envelope) is an acceptable second reject trigger but must not be the only one. The label names both endpoints and why the wall fails all the way to each.
- **C2 Session S1, non-Pro guided (`arkit`), 6–10 min, phone upright at chest height (~1.4 m):**
  1. Start 3–4 m from the meter facing it; hold 2 s until tracking `normal`; tap `meter`, confirm.
  2. Walk left parallel to the wall at 2–4 m (≥ 2 keyframes/s, ~60 % overlap, wall filling most of the frame, no sky- or lawn-only frames) to the natural end; turn corners in 2–3 steps; continue on the adjacent wall to 8 m from the meter or its end; tap `corner` / `wall_end_left`.
  3. Return past the meter without stopping the session and repeat to the right; tap `wall_end_right`.
  4. Head-on pass: from 3 m out, one perpendicular view of every wall face within 8 m, including every entry or garage door head-on (`ext.doorViews`).
  5. Ground pass: two passes at 2 m and 4 m out, camera ~45° down, covering the strip out to 3.7 m (12 ft) on open sides.
  6. Overhead pass: from 3 m out, tilt up to eaves, soffit or porch roof above candidate spots, 2–3 frames per 3 m of wall.
  7. Taps as present: `gas_meter`, `ac_unit`, `door_corner` ×2 per door, `window_corner` ×2 (bottom corners) per ground-floor window within 8 m, `fence`, `driveway_edge`.
  8. Bridge to the meter (3 m → 1 m, meter in frame); `meter_close` head-on at ~1 m, then `meter_oblique` ~30° to one side at the same distance (`side` recorded); whole cover, ring and socket face ≈ half the frame, plate legible. Then `meter_surround` from ~8 m, `meter_left`, `meter_right`, `adjacent_wall`, `behind_fence` only through an open gate.
  9. Panel, same session if reachable (exterior, or garage with the door open): bridge frames to it, `panel_surround`, `panel_close` (door closed), `panel_open` (door open, dead-front ON), `main_disconnect` if separate. Never remove a dead-front.
  10. Close the loop past the start; accept a TrueDepth prompt if offered; end. Expect 150–300 keyframes, 45–200 MB.
- **C3 Session S2, non-Pro photo flow, 60–70 JPEGs** (A10 §7 shot list ≈ 40 photos weighted to the meter side; 60–70 here because A10 §3.3 needed 60–70 frames per ≈ 35 m side on its dimmest real session, and 40 frames spread ≈ 1 m apart registered only 2–7 of 40: density per side, one photo per 0.5–1 m step, is what registers): 20–30 along the meter wall every 0.5–1 m at 2–4 m out with half overlap, to both natural ends and past them; 10–15 around each corner (45° at the corners) and along adjacent walls head-on from 2–4 m to 8 m; 5 head-on per wall face; 6 ground photos looking down from chest height at 2 m and 4 m out (strip to ≈ 13 ft); 3 eave/overhead incl. one looking up above the meter; 3 bridge photos walking in (3 → 2 → 1.5 m); `meter_close` head-on and `meter_oblique`; 3 `meter_surround` from ~8 m; panel photos as in S1 step 9. Fill `photo_purposes.csv` (`filename,purpose`) during capture. A7's rules apply to S1–S3 alike: slow steady walk, no panning while moving (≤ 7–10°/s at 1/60 s, ≈ 4 px of blur), daylight ≥ ≈ 1,000 lux on the wall (ISO ≤ 100–200), wall base and ≥ 1 m of ground in frame with the phone level.
- **C4 Session S3, LiDAR phone guided (`arkit_lidar`):** S1 verbatim with `sceneDepthEnabled` and depth + confidence on every keyframe; export `geometry/mesh.ply` if the app can. Optional S1b: repeat S1 near dusk if ≥ 30 min remain (A7 tables show dusk breaking registration).
- **C5 Truth survey, after the captures (no tape in any frame), two people, laser first, tape as a check on ≥ 3 distances.** Mark stations with painter's tape; s = 0 at the meter glass centre, positive to the right seen from outside. Measure, each with a photo of the reading and both endpoints: `meter.height` (grade to glass centre, plus can bottom and top); every `corner.s`; `wall.length` of every chain wall within 8 m; for every opening within 8 m both `opening.edge_s` (outer trim face; record `edge_def`), `bottom`, `top`, `width`, and `opening.gap` to the next opening; `equipment.meter_dist` and `equipment.s` for gas meter, regulator, AC, hose bib, downspout, wall boxes, vents; `facing.depth` at 3 stations where an obstacle is < 4 m; `overhead.clearance` at 3 stations where < 3 m; `ground.region_dist` to drive, walkway and pool edges, plus material and slope (level over a 1.8 m run) at each candidate spot; the capturer's phone height. Minimum 12 KDs, ≥ 3 in the 4.57–7.92 m (15–26 ft) band, ≥ 2 openings fully measured (the plan says 5–10 check distances; 12 covers every KD family) `[default chosen]`. Declared bounds: laser 0.010 m, tape 0.015 m `[default chosen]` (≥ 4× tighter than the 2–6 in bar).
- **C6 Meter caliper, nothing opened, seal untouched:** cover OD in two perpendicular directions, ring OD, base OD if visible, rim offset from the socket face, material, `type_code` from the plate; photos with the reading; plate photo with the meter number covered. Row → `meter_models.v1.json` as `caliper`.
- **C7 Panel truth:** brand as printed (or `unreadable`), main breaker amps, P13 hazard signs (spec §6), wall face relative to the meter (P5), `panel_in_house` truth.

### D. Post-capture (PR-B)
1. Pull sessions off the phones the same day; originals go to the private bucket (`gs://hss-fixtures-<env>/real-house/<id>/raw/`, WS-12) and nowhere else.
2. `uv run python scripts/real_house/scrub_packet.py --in RAW --out /tmp/real-001/<session> --drop k00117,k00118` (frames failing C1); exit 4 = stop. `uv run python -m packetgen validate /tmp/real-001/<session>/packet.json` with hashes on. Tar per §3.4; store split-tar mirror, bucket copy, manifest item, committed `packet.json`.
3. `truth.json` from the field sheet within 48 h; `truth_to_scene.py --truth ... --site real-001 --out data/fixtures/scenes/real-001/gt-tape/scene.json`; `uv run python -m server.eval.cli validate` on it.
4. Labels **blind**: hand-work `real-001` and `real-002` in `internal/criteria/house-labels.json` from photos and truth *before* any pipeline run; record the export timestamp; export; mirror. Approval per §E. R1 gets, per profile A/B/C/S, `start_range` labels on the meter wall: the feasible band `{wall_id, start_s_m: [s0, s1], truth: "pass"}` (battery left-edge positions the truth clears with margin ≥ 0.15 m on every check), `fail` bands where a check clearly fails, `borderline` within 0.15 m of any threshold (0.15 m = the 6 in bar `[default chosen]`), with `value_ft`/`plus_minus_ft` for the binding distance; site labels `pass` for every profile and `site_decision: pass`. R2 gets `fail` bands over the whole wall and `site_decision: reject` (C, S) / `manual_review` (A, B, which cannot reject). These are the first `pass` labels in the dataset (E2E §7: none exist on ETH3D or the walkarounds; the YouTube houses in §B4 will not yield one, because their ground strips are unobserved and the correct output is review).
5. Run the pipeline: `uv run python -m server.eval.replay --packet .fixtures/packets/real-001-<yyyymmdd>-<n>.tar --api $CAPTURE_API_URL --token-env CAPTURE_API_TOKEN --finalize-at last --until verdict --timeout 1200 --out runs/replay/real-001-<yyyymmdd>-<n>.json` (SD-36 flags; SD-44 ids, no `--variant`) for the three sessions; offline fallback `make e2e-local` style run on a laptop. Keep every run's `scene/scene.json`, `verdicts/verdict.{A,B,C,S}.json`, `scale/scale.json`, `coverage/coverage_report.json` (its `views_needed`), `run/timings.json` and VLM cost.
6. Score: `uv run python -m server.eval.cli score-geometry --gt data/fixtures/scenes/real-001/gt-tape/scene.json --recon OUT/scene.json --out $S/internal/eval-harness/results/real-001/<session>/` (if it requires GT assets, use `score_kds.py` and file a WS-11 request for `--no-visibility` on `score-geometry`); `score-verdicts --verdict OUT/verdict.C.json --labels data/fixtures/labels/real-001.C.json` and the other profiles; `redact.py` on every stored read output before committing `data/fixtures/real-house/real-001/scores/`.
7. Recalibrate `nonlidar_modern`: `uv run python -m packetgen.calibrate --session /tmp/real-001/guided-nonpro --truth data/fixtures/real-house/real-001/truth.json` (new `--session/--truth` mode `[default chosen]`) using `streams/arkit_poses.csv.gz` against the WS-04 refined poses and the tape KDs (PR #12 metric: displacement error over D ft walked). Write it as `nonlidar_modern` with `basis: "real-001 guided-nonpro, n_sessions 1"`, keep the old profile as `nonlidar_modern_assumed`, update `calibration.md`, and report the ARKit session scale error vs tape next to A6's real 1.2 % / 2.8 % (`A6-iphone-quality.md` §3.1) and the assumed 2.6 / 5.1 %.
8. Append `real-001` and `real-002` rows (per session: KDs scored/missing, median/p90/max in, scale error, `scale.status`, site decision vs label, `outcome.kind`, placement inside the labelled band yes/no, unsafe passes, decidability = `criteria_report.decidability.<profile>.share` (candidate × criterion cells decided pass or fail) reported per profile against WS-11's `gates.yaml` `decidability` block (SD-49: hard rows only on the laser GT scenes, facade ≥ 0.38 / electro ≥ 0.75; photo WARN below 0.29 on facade `colmap-nonlidar`; baselines photo 12–13 % / 24–25 %, laser 38 % / 75 %; A10's COLMAP photo-flow scenes 23 % / 31–38 %), with no hard row for the real houses until their labels land, `frame_budget.mapper_frames`, `photo_spacing` (WS-04), runtime, VLM cost) to `internal/eval-harness/README.md` "Final results"; write `docs/real-house-validation.md` (store, the plan's report; plan paths are store paths) and `docs/components/ws-13-real-house.md` (repo, WS-00 template sections) `[default chosen]`. Steps 1–8 run for both houses; R2 needs at least the truth of its binding distances (§8 gate 6).

2. Hunter approves in a PR-B review comment or a line in `docs/house-labels.md` ("Approved by Hunter YYYY-MM-DD: sites …"); the builder records `approval: {status: "approved", by, on, ref}` per house in `house-labels.json` and extends `export_labels_v0.py` so `labeller` reads `Track C criteria worker (approved by Hunter YYYY-MM-DD)` for approved houses and `(draft, for Hunter's approval)` otherwise `[default chosen]`.

### G. LaMAR real-phone regression data (WS-11 consumes via `make lamar`)
The A6 fetchers exist only on that agent's VM (`~/lamar/fetch_meta.py`, `~/lamar/fetch_par.py`) and are described, not stored (`internal/context-dumps/full/a6-iphone-quality.md` §3 steps 1–2; WS-11's start gate assumes "the A6 `setup.sh` recipe" fetches them, which it does not). Rewrite them under `scripts/lamar/` (WS-13-owned; `server/eval/lamar/` stays WS-11's) `[default chosen]`: `scripts/lamar/fetch_meta.py` = remotezip extraction of `trajectories.txt`, `images.txt`, `sensors.txt` for every `raw/LIN/sessions/ios_*.zip` into `<data>/raw/<s>/`, plus `LIN/sparse/{cameras,frames,rigs,images,points3D}.bin` and `LIN/pose_covariances.txt` from `colmap/LIN.zip` into `<data>/colmap/`, then the GT dump `gt_ios.json` (13,398 frames) and `gt_navvis.json` (3,972) via `lamar_io.load_gt`; `scripts/lamar/fetch_frames.py` = 12 threads with one `RemoteZip` each (≈ 15 files/s) or `curl` + `unzip -q -o $s.zip "$s/raw_data/images/*"` for `ios_2022-06-17_10.43.29`, `ios_2022-02-10_14.47.24`, `ios_2021-06-02_11.12.32` (0.5–1.3 GB each, ≈ 27 MB/s); `scripts/lamar/fetch_lamar.sh <data>` runs both, checks the licence line (`curl -sL https://cvg-data.inf.ethz.ch/lamar/INFO | grep -i licen` → CC BY-SA 4.0), runs `build_laser.py` (≈ 12 min), copies `internal/breadth/a6-iphone-quality/results/segments.json`, and writes sha256 + sizes into `data/fixtures/manifest.json` items (`committed: false`). Raw data (≈ 6.1 GB) and derived arrays never enter git; derived arrays are share-alike, internal only. Gate value decided (SD-40): `openings_p90_in_max: 4.6` (A6 handoff §7); the measured per-segment p90 2.8 / 4.1 / 3.9 / 4.2 / 3.9 in are reported as is, the 4.2 in figure (plan WS-11, old `gates.yaml`) is superseded; 15–26 ft p90 ≤ 12.4 in on the worst segment and the floor 1.7 / 5.4 in stay reported, not gated. These fetchers also feed WS-04's own acceptance run on the five segments (WS-04 §8.6), so PR-A ships them before WS-04's PR needs them.

- A9 `internal/breadth/a9-no-tape/results/meter_model_check.csv` and handoff §6: seed data. B2 `internal/breadth/b2/inputs/meter_manifest.csv`: photo list for WS-05's contour test (its `title`/`page_url` columns carry digit runs: never copy it into the repo, WS-08 §2).
- Licences: LaMAR CC BY-SA 4.0 (internal evaluation, derived data share-alike); ETH3D CC BY-NC-SA and YouTube frames never in a public repo; datasheets copyrighted (numbers cited, PDFs kept private); exiftool (Perl Artistic/GPL) used as a tool only.

| New YouTube packets (§B) | `archives/{yt-KSXy6LFwQU4,yt-Y0DSQekoV_g,yt-olz1uwI4vM8}.tar` | est. 20–60 MB | image branch; `KSXy` = meter + AC + deck (crowded wall), `Y0DS` = porch overhang, `olz` = brick scale, ultra-wide |

## 7. Commands
```bash
S=/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2; export FIXTURE_SOURCE=$S/internal
make setup && make fixtures ONLY=small && make validate                                   # WS-00, < 5 min
sudo apt-get install -y libimage-exiftool-perl p7zip-full
cp -r $S/internal/packet-generator ~/work/packetgen                                        # store FS is slow: run from local disk
(cd ~/work/packetgen && uv run python -m packetgen manifest --out ~/work/packets --only yt-KSXy6LFwQU4 yt-Y0DSQekoV_g yt-olz1uwI4vM8)  # 5–15 min/house
(cd ~/work/packetgen && uv run python -m packetgen validate ~/work/packets/yt-KSXy6LFwQU4/packet.*.json)                              # < 1 min
uv run python $S/internal/criteria/export_labels_v0.py                                     # "52 files written and valid" after §B
uv run python scripts/meter_models/validate_table.py data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json  # < 1 s
uv run python scripts/real_house/scrub_packet.py --in ~/raw/real-001/guided-nonpro --out /tmp/real-001/guided-nonpro
(cd ~/work/packetgen && uv run python -m packetgen validate /tmp/real-001/guided-nonpro/packet.json)
uv run python scripts/real_house/truth_to_scene.py --truth data/fixtures/real-house/real-001/truth.json --site real-001 \
  --out data/fixtures/scenes/real-001/gt-tape/scene.json && uv run python -m server.eval.cli validate data/fixtures/scenes/real-001/gt-tape/scene.json
uv run python -m server.eval.replay --packet .fixtures/packets/real-001-20261004-1.tar --api $CAPTURE_API_URL \
  --token-env CAPTURE_API_TOKEN --finalize-at last --until verdict --timeout 1200 --out runs/replay/real-001-20261004-1.json   # dev stack, ≤ 20 min; SD-44 id (date = capture day), no --variant; SD-36 flags
uv run python -m server.eval.cli score-geometry --gt data/fixtures/scenes/real-001/gt-tape/scene.json --recon runs/replay/real-001-20261004-1/scene.json \
  --out $S/internal/eval-harness/results/real-001/guided-nonpro                             # 15–60 s
uv run python -m server.eval.cli score-verdicts --verdict runs/replay/real-001-20261004-1/verdict.C.json \
  --labels data/fixtures/labels/real-001.C.json --out $S/internal/eval-harness/results/real-001/verdictscores
(cd ~/work/packetgen && uv run python -m packetgen.calibrate --session /tmp/real-001/guided-nonpro --truth data/fixtures/real-house/real-001/truth.json)  # ≈ 2 min
bash scripts/lamar/fetch_lamar.sh ~/lamar                                                  # ≈ 20 min download + 12 min laser, CPU
uv run pytest scripts/real_house/tests scripts/meter_models/tests -q && (cd ~/work/packetgen && uv run python -m pytest -q)
```
Everything is CPU (4 vCPU laptop or VM) except the pipeline run, which uses WS-12's Modal L4 `dev` deployment.

## 8. Done when
PR-A:
1. `validate_table.py` exits 0; ≥ 20 entries; ≥ 3 with `usable_for_scale: true`; no numeric `assumed` outside `generic-prior`; every non-caliper, non-missing number has `source.url` and `accessed`.
2. Three new packets validate on every variant; `internal/data/packets/index.json` lists 12 houses with `not_built: []`; store parts ≤ 100 MiB; `make validate` green with the committed manifests.
3. `export_labels_v0.py` prints `52 files written and valid`; `data/fixtures/labels/` mirrors them; `docs/house-labels.md` is v0.6.
4. `internal/build/fold-ins/B3-cheap-gate.md` holds the §F row-1 deltas and `internal/build/fold-ins/modal-benchmark.md` the §F Modal row (48-frame budget, A1/A6 port source, pycolmap line, warm-container facts, $0.05–0.15 GPU per house); `docs/evidence-register.md` has the WS-03/WS-04/WS-07/WS-08/WS-12 rows; one issue per owner is open.
PR-B:
5. Packets `real-00{1,2}-<yyyymmdd>-{1,2,3}` (SD-44 ids; each a variant-less `packet.json` folder) validate with hashes and `make fixtures ITEM=<id>` fetches each by id; each scrub report lists `location`, `serviceAddress` and GPS as removed; the validator finds no face, plate or house number in 20 sampled frames per house.
6. R1 `truth.json` has ≥ 12 KDs (≥ 3 in 4.57–7.92 m, ≥ 2 full openings) and the clear span's binding distances (drive, gas, facing, overhead, nearest opening); R2 `truth.json` has ≥ 6 KDs including every distance its reject rests on and both wall-end `corner.s` or `limit` positions; every KD has a `photo`; both `gt-tape/scene.json` validate; both caliper rows are in the table.
7. Labels `real-00{1,2}.{A,B,C,S}.json` exported before the first pipeline run (export timestamp < first `ReplayRun.timings` start, both in the report); R1 carries ≥ 1 `start_range` label with `truth: pass` per profile and `site_decision: pass`; R2 carries `site_decision: reject` under C and S.
8. E2E: replay → `verdict_ready` for R1 and R2 `guided-nonpro` and `photo-nonpro` within 20 min each (plan hard stop); `score-verdicts` under every profile: `unsafe_passes 0`, `false_rejections 0`, and R2's `site.decision` is `reject` under C and S (`manual_review` is over-caution: reported, not a failure) with `outcome.kind ∈ {not_eligible, manual_review}`, never `eligible`.
9. Geometry on R1 `guided-nonpro`: KDs measured in `truth.json` and `observed` in the recon score `p90_in ≤ 6.0` (plan WS-13 "within 6 in p90"); `scale.rel_bound_95 ≤ 0.02` with `scale.status ≠ unverified` (the caliper row guarantees a table hit); R2, `guided-lidar` and `photo-nonpro` numbers reported alongside as targets, not gates (LiDAR: p90 ≤ 4.0 in, |scale error| ≤ 1 % `[default chosen]`).
10. **Pass path exercised.** On R1 `guided-nonpro` at least one profile among C and A yields `verdicts/verdict.<P>.json` `site.decision == pass` and `result/result.json` `outcome.kind == eligible` (SD-25/SD-26 camelCase on the wire), with `outcome.recommendedPlacement.wallId` equal to a labelled `pass` band's `wall_id` and `outcome.recommendedPlacement.startSM` inside that band's `start_s_m` (chain `s` in metres from the meter, as SD-39's positive-pass rows; plan §5, labels §D4); `score-verdicts` for that profile reports `pass_recall ≥ 1` labelled pass position hit and `unsafe_passes 0`. Reads: the meter number is confirmed by the team through `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations` (SD-21: `fieldId: meter_number`, `kind: confirmed|corrected`, `imageId`; WS-01 serves it, WS-08's `policy.confirm` applies it) or, if that route is not deployed yet, WS-10's reviewer confirm, before `eligible` is read; a run that stops at `manual_review` only because the meter number is unconfirmed is recorded, then rerun after the confirm. Reaching `eligible` only under `photo-nonpro` or `guided-lidar` does not satisfy this gate; report them.
11. `profiles.json` `nonlidar_modern.basis` names `real-001`; `nonlidar_modern_assumed` kept; `calibration.md` updated; packetgen tests green.
12. `bash scripts/lamar/fetch_lamar.sh ~/lamar` then `uv run python $S/internal/breadth/a6-iphone-quality/arkit_scale.py` prints `pair_abs_err_in_med 3.58, p90 12.56`; `gt_ios.json` has 13,398 frames.
13. `internal/eval-harness/README.md` has the `real-001` and `real-002` rows; `docs/real-house-validation.md` and `docs/components/ws-13-real-house.md` exist; `internal/build/fold-ins/{E2E-criteria-on-recon,A7-iphone-degradation,A10-sparse-photo-flow}.md` hold the §F deltas (the A7 file marks its pending conditions and is re-issued when the report is refreshed); `make e2e` on the golden packets and `make validate` stay green; `make hygiene` reports no tracked file > 5 MB.
If gate 8, 9 or 10 fails, WS-13 is not done: file the failing KDs, criteria or the blocking read policy to the owning WS (WS-04/05/06/08/09/10), rerun after their fix, and keep every iteration in `docs/real-house-validation.md`.

## 9. Validator checklist
1. Re-run the §7 commands from `export_labels_v0.py` onward on a clean checkout, for both houses; numbers must match the builder's report (KD errors within 0.1 in, same unsafe-pass count, same `scale.status`, same `outcome.kind`).
2. Privacy sweep: `git ls-files -z | xargs -0 du -b | awk '$1>5242880'` prints nothing; `rg -n '[0-9]{8,}' data docs scripts | rg -v 'sha256|bytes|uuid|https?://'` shows no meter-number-like string; `exiftool -gps:all -j` on 10 random keyframes of each published packet returns nothing; `packet.json` has no `streams.location`, `serviceAddress`, city or street.
3. Open 5 random measurement photos: each reading equals `truth.json` within its bound. Re-derive 5 random labels from the frames.
4. Confirm the blind order (gate 7) from the timestamps in the report.
5. Open 5 cited datasheet URLs and confirm label and value; confirm no numeric `assumed` outside `generic-prior`; confirm `TARGET_MODELS.md` marks unconfirmed families `not found`.
6. Diff `internal/build/fold-ins/B3-cheap-gate.md` against `internal/breadth/B3-cheap-gate.md` §1 and §3.1 line by line.
7. Gate 10 by hand: open R1's `result/result.json` and the C (or A) labels file; check `outcome.kind == eligible`, that `outcome.recommendedPlacement.startSM` lies inside a `truth: pass` band on the same wall (`wallId` = the label's `wall_id`), and that the band's `why` cites truth measurements; walk the reviewer view to confirm the placement box sits on the measured clear span; confirm the meter-number confirmation arrived as a `confirmation` event (SD-19) or a reviewer override, never by flipping `HSS_READS_AUTOFILL_NO_BARCODE`.
8. File `internal/build/validation/ws-13.md`: pass/fail per gate 1–13, commands run, numbers, sampled items, defects; fail the WS if any `[default chosen]` is missing from `internal/build/layout-decisions-ws-13.md`.

## 10. Constraints
- Vision models GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only (cheap tiers GPT-5.4-mini, Grok 4.20 NR from OpenAI/xAI); no Anthropic anywhere.
- Never commit real meter numbers (labels, truth and stored outputs say `REDACTED`), Base SSR prompt text, API keys or tokens (env names only: `CAPTURE_API_URL`, `CAPTURE_API_TOKEN`, `FIXTURE_SOURCE`, `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH`), or any file over 5 MB; never paste secret values into reports.
- No customer tools in any capture assumption: tape, laser and caliper are team truth tools used after the captures; no packet or label refers to a homeowner measurement.
- Homeowner addresses, GPS, faces and plates stay out of the repo and the store (scrubbed packets, state-only location, consent forms private). Never touch the meter seal, open a meter, or remove a panel dead-front; ladders only for the eave measurement, two people.
- Spend caps for this WS `[default chosen]`: VLM ≤ $2 per pipeline run, ≤ 12 runs; Modal ≤ $30; everything else CPU.
- ETH3D-derived assets and YouTube frames stay out of any public repo (`data/fixtures/LICENCE-NOTES.md`).

## 11. Out of scope and handoffs
- Table loader (`server/scale/meter_table.py`), contour fitter, two-view rim, `scale/scale.json`, `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH` reading: WS-05 (receives the JSON, schema, validator, `caliper` rows and coverage count; hands back `scale/meter_models.pending.jsonl`).
- Replay client, gates (`openings_p90_in_max: 4.6`, SD-40), `make lamar`, `--no-visibility` on `score-geometry`, reference-score rows: WS-11 (receives the LaMAR fetchers and real-house scores). WS-04 runs the five segments as its own acceptance with the same fetchers.
- Packet validation code and `NormalizedPacket`: WS-02 (receives the recalibrated profile and the real packets); pose recipe, the 48-frame mapper budget and σ sweeps on the real capture: WS-04; ARKit-plane wall completion validated for real on these captures: WS-06 (the real packets are the first with `planes[]` and `corner` / `wall_end_*` taps; capture step C2.2 and C2.7 supply them).
- Detection cascade and read policy: WS-07/WS-08 (fold-in deltas only); the confirmation route used for gate 10: WS-01 `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations` (SD-21) with WS-10's reviewer confirm as fallback. iOS app, capture prompts, spec upkeep, in-app photo flow: WS-14 (receives a list of capture steps the app made hard or impossible, and the LCPB registration evidence for keeping ARKit running through the close-ups).
- Fixture bucket `gs://hss-fixtures-<env>`, image contents (`data/meter-models/` via `add_local_dir` on `GPU_IMAGE`, `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH` in `secrets_for("pipeline")`, SD-59): WS-12.
- Editing `docs/server-pipeline-build-plan.md` and the gate decision's cost table: the coordinator, from `internal/build/fold-ins/`.

## 12. Open questions and defaults
1. iOS v0.4 app build available on capture day? Default: proceed; photo flow via stock Camera, guided via Measure Lab scored offline; guided E2E marked "pending app".
2. Which house? Default: a team member's own house meeting §C1; Texas preferred, any state accepted.
3. Bucket name? Default: store split-tar mirror as the manifest `source` until WS-12 provides `gs://hss-fixtures-<env>`.
4. E2E gate profile? Default: C (`RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT`), all four profiles scored and reported.
5. `score-geometry` on a GT scene without assets? Default: `score_kds.py` results are acceptable for gate 9; WS-11 request filed.
6. Base's meter model census? Default: `TARGET_MODELS.md`; replace when Base answers (A9 handoff §9).
7. Hunter unavailable for approval? Default: labels stay `draft`, still scored, reported as draft.
8. R2 not available on capture day? Default: capture R1, report R2 as pending; gate 8's reject half stays open (a pass-site-only WS-13 is not done).
9. Measure Lab lacks `imuRaw` / 30 Hz poses: Default: `source.kind: replay`, offline scoring only, never uploaded.
10. Real-house manifest name `packet.json` vs WS-00's `packet.<variant>.json`? Decided (SD-44): real sessions are variant-less folders with `packet.json`, manifest id `<site>-<yyyymmdd>-<n>`; `fetch_fixtures`, `check-packets`, `server.eval.replay` and `make e2e` resolve `packet.json` first, else `packet.<variant>.json`, and reject `--variant` on a variant-less folder; fetch single items with `make fixtures ITEM=real-001-20261004-1` (SD-28).
11. Confirmation path for the meter number when gate 10 is run: `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations` (SD-21, WS-01/WS-14) with `fieldId: meter_number`. Default if it is not deployed: the team confirms through the WS-10 reviewer override; if that does not exist either, record the `manual_review` caused only by the unconfirmed read and rerun once it lands; never flip `HSS_READS_AUTOFILL_NO_BARCODE` (SD-11 name) to reach `eligible`.
12. R1's site `pass` blocked by an unclean feature read other than the meter number (CL320 label, can size)? Default: report the blocking criterion and rerun after the read is confirmed in the reviewer view; gate 10 is judged on the confirmed run.
